title: Umphefumlo Wesigulana
intro: Kwiingxelo zobungqina, kwakukho umphefumlo omonde wawo wawubhalwe ngokoqobo emzimbeni wawo. Ngeenyembezi nexesha, babambelela ngokuqinileyo ethembeni, baba ngumzekelo ongapheliyo wokuthembela kubulumko bukaThixo. Ungasityhila na imfihlakalo yalo mntu ungagungqiyo?
clues: Ndazalelwa kusapho lwabaprofeti, kodwa uvavanyo lwam olukhulu lwavela kumntwana endandimthanda kakhulu.
Ndifumene isilumkiso somona kwiphupha unyana wam alithethayo, kwaye ndandisoyika ukhuseleko lwakhe.
Amehlo am ajika aba mhlophe ngenxa yosizi, kodwa andizange ndilahle ukholo kwinceba ka-Allah.
Ivumba lomntwana wam olahlekileyo landifikelela livela kude, ndaza ndazi ngoko ukuba ukudibana kwakhona kusondele.
Usapho lwam lwaguqa lubulela xa umbono wakudala wazaliseka, kwaye amehlo am abuyiselwa.
Ndingulowo wanikwa ihempe enegazi, kodwa kamva ndafumana ihempe eyandiphilisayo.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
